_comment_physics: Long-run dendrite config: moderate undercooling (delta = 0.7) and strong cubic anisotropy (epsilon = 0.15 > 1/15, where the unregularised equation is ill-posed, so willmore_beta > 0 is required). willmore_beta = 0.401 = |S| l*^2 with S = (1 + eps)(1 - 15 eps) = -1.4375 and the corner length l* = 0.528 W0 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3).
_comment_grid: 192^3 = 7.08M points, box 76.4 W0. Measured on an RTX 4090: the solver allocates 0.72 GiB of GPU memory (108 bytes per cell of fields with willmore_beta > 0, plus 7 MiB), 113 MB per checkpoint, up to 88 MB per .vts.
_comment_time: Euler with the linearly implicit Willmore step. dt = 0.0003125 is the largest of the candidates 0.02, 0.01, 0.005, ... (each half the previous) whose time error does not exceed the spatial error of h = 0.4 in the max norm and in the mean, both measured with this configuration's physics in a box of side 50.4 up to t = 15 (docs/THEORY.md section 4.3). The explicit thermal update is stable for dt <= 0.026087 (27-point stencil, h = 0.4, D = 2; docs/THEORY.md section 10.1). max_steps = 960000 (t = 300) is an upper bound: exit_on_saturation stops the run cleanly, with a final checkpoint and VTK frame, once phi > saturation_threshold next to a wall (measured: step 113600, t = 35.5, when the six <100> tips reach the walls). A step takes 14.4 ms on an RTX 4090 (median of 200 steps), so the 113600 steps to saturation are 27 minutes of compute at that rate.
_comment_output: VTK every 8000 steps (2.5 time units): 16 frames up to saturation, up to 88 MB each, 1.06 GB in total.
_comment_checkpoint: Checkpoint every 48000 steps (15 time units, 11.5 minutes of compute at 14.4 ms per step on an RTX 4090), keep_last = 3 (340 MB). The resume target picks the latest intact checkpoint.
